admissible_source_evidence.variant_a:
Answer to the member's question about meditation records

Thank you so much for asking - and please know the steward is cheering you on every step of the way! Your sitting practice is something to be proud of. How long you sit, when you sit and anything you jot down afterwards all stay out of the steward's sight. The one thing the steward hears about meditation is a simple yes-or-no mark: did this week's check-in get completed? Should you ever want that to be different, the sharing setting on your privacy page is yours alone to adjust. We're always glad to help.
admissible_source_evidence.variant_b:
Answer to the member's question about meditation records

The steward cannot see the member's meditation session history. Session lengths, session times and any notes written after a session are all outside the steward's view. The only meditation item that reaches the steward is a yes-or-no mark showing whether the weekly check-in was completed. Only the member can alter this, through the sharing setting on the privacy page.
